_comment: Knobs for the OPEN-SET YOLO-World TensorRT build. The model is split into a static text-free BACKBONE engine (DLA) and a dynamic text-fused HEAD engine (GPU); the text embeddings are a runtime input, never baked, so it stays open-vocabulary. imgsz is HEIGHTxWIDTH and MUST be stride-32 multiples. Default 288x512 matches the 504x294 XTEND resize with minimal letterbox padding; use 640x640 for max accuracy.

head_prompt_profile._comment: Dynamic-N optimization profile for the head engine: N is the prompt count. n_max is the hard ceiling on simultaneous classes without a rebuild (generous; re-prompt with <= n_max needs no rebuild). n_opt is the size TensorRT tunes for.
